concept: Concert Hall Classic - a timeless music-shop palette anchored by a rich, trustworthy navy primary and a warm brass/gold accent that nods to horns and instrument hardware. A burgundy secondary adds velvet-curtain warmth, while deep charcoal ink sits on soft warm-cream backgrounds for a friendly, established, highly legible feel.
contrastNotes: All required ratios verified WCAG-AA+. ink(#1A1613) on bg(#FAF5EA) = 16.53:1 (>=7); ink-soft(#544A3E) on bg = 7.96:1 (>=4.5); white on primary(#1C2E52) = 13.44:1 (>=4.5); primary on bg = 12.36:1 (>=3). Bonus: ink on surface 17.98:1; ink on surface-alt 14.67:1; ink-soft on surface-alt 7.06:1; ink-soft on surface 8.66:1; white on primary-dark 16.26:1; white on secondary(burgundy #7A2433) 9.87:1; secondary on bg 9.08:1. Brass-gold accent(#AD831F) is reserved for decorative use and large/bold text or UI accents (3.20:1 on bg, 3.48:1 white-on-accent, both pass AA for large text/non-text UI) and is not relied on for body-text contrast. Line color is decorative (non-text).
